input.description: Telemetry shows oil pressure steadily declining from 35.7 psi to ~18 psi over ~90 minutes, then plateauing near 18-19 psi while coolant temp (88-90°C) and RPM (1600-1700) stayed normal — indicating a genuine, sustained low-pressure condition rather than sensor noise or an overheating-driven artifact. Only one relevant KB entry (KB-004) was found, so there is no conflicting guidance: it states low oil pressure warnings on diesel engines are not resolved by sensor restart and require a service visit. Service history shows the oil pressure sensor was already replaced in March for an unrelated fault, further supporting a real mechanical cause (e.g., pump wear, leak, or low oil level) rather than sensor fault. Recommending scheduling a service visit.
